summary: RptMnuSetupProf_Closure is a web user control for generating a 'Destination Closures' report in a web application. It allows users to select an agency and one or more sites, then runs a report for the selected parameters. The result is provided as a downloadable CSV file.
purpose: To enable users to generate and download closure reports (in CSV/XML formats) for selected agencies and sites, supporting both default and alternate language column titles.

fields.name: lblDescription
fields.description: Contains description text for the report menu.

fields.name: lbSites
fields.description: Listbox for selecting Sites associated with selected Agency.

fields.name: btnRunReport
fields.description: Button to run the report generation.

fields.name: litMessage
fields.description: Displays messages, such as errors or notification of status.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Interacts with the UI to select agency/site and trigger report generation.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Handles fetching agencies/sites, running SQL, and generating/reporting files.

workflows.name: Generate Closure Report
steps: Page loads: If ddAgency is empty, populate it with agencies available to UserSession.
User selects an agency from ddAgency. Site list (lbSites) is populated based on agency selection.
User selects one or more sites from lbSites.
System builds SQL query with selected agency and site IDs.
System calls WizardsController.ExportSQLtoXML to export data to XML.
System constructs column title mappings for default and alternate (French) languages.
System generates closure report as CSV and XML using the Report object.
If successful, system displays hyperlink (aReportFile) for downloading CSV file.
If report generation fails, system displays error message in litMessage.

business_rules: Agencies shown must be accessible for the UserSession.
Site list (lbSites) is cleared and hidden when agency value is 0 (blank entry).
If user does not select valid agency or site, report generation is not executed.
Column titles support localization, default and alternate language (French).
validations: Validate that both agency and at least one site are selected before running report.
Validate that dropdown and listbox controls are not null before processing.
calculations: Build SQL query to include selected agency and comma-separated site IDs.
Generate report headers from selected agency and site names.
conditions: If ddAgency.SelectedItem.Value is 0 (blank), lbSites and aReportFile are hidden.
If lbSites has more than one site, set rows to 12; otherwise, set to 1.
Show litMessage if report generation returns 0 (failure).
system_behavior: Populates agency dropdown and site list dynamically.
Generates file paths with unique GUID for each report session.
Handles visibility and messaging based on workflow success/failure.
exceptions: If agency or site controls are null, or no valid selections, report generation is aborted.
If ExportSQLtoXML returns 0 or another failure, user is notified and no file link is shown.
content_gaps: Details on exact report content and columns beyond summary were not provided.
Error handling and user notification specifics are limited.
No explicit definition of the Report class or its methods was found.
